focus: package (title + thumbnail) mining, weak contrasts for Bible Shorts and longs
verdict: NOT VALIDATED. No package driver, no gate. The 27/10 state stands: hygiene only.

budget.balance_basis: 3,261 before the day's reads (daily-analysis.json), 40 spent earlier today, 5 now; research credits in the ledger 1,350 of 2,000 per cycle

existing_records_checked.result: Weak contrasts with package data exist only as the same 3 Shorts (2 channels) and 3 longs (3 channels) already counted on 27/10; the 26/10 records hold the same videos. Other low-view videos in older records are the retired prayer niche (different form) and carry no thumbnail coding. No new weak contrast was available offline.

new_call.query: bible story shorts KJV, type video, duration short, order date, since 2026-08-01, limit 50
why_unusable_as_weak_contrasts: No channel norm (outlierScore and vph null on every row): 'at or below the channel norm' cannot be measured, and model estimates do not replace counts.
Age confounded: all 50 were published 25-28/10 (0-3 days old); views at that age do not separate weak from winner.
Mixed forms: many are devotional verse-audio clips of 5-60 s, not 60-180 s story Shorts; only a minority are same-form.
Channels are tiny (0-14,200 subscribers; median about 100) and the sample is the latest uploads, not a winners' own-channel comparison.
Shorts only, so longs gained 0 weak contrasts.

gate_arithmetic.short: weak 3 from 2 channels; need >= 6 from >= 4 channels: missing 3 weak and 2 channels
gate_arithmetic.long: weak 3 from 3 channels; need >= 6 from >= 4: missing 3 weak and 1 channel

question_titles.decision_28_10: DECISIONS 28/10 proposed question titles for genesis-09..11.
question_titles.evidence_market: 27/10 (not re-measured): question in 2/27 Shorts winners by the title coder, opponent-or-question 14/27 (52 %), same form 10/18 (56 %); label-only titles win too (13/27); weak 0/3. Below the 70 % driver bar. Not validated.
question_titles.evidence_own_today: Our own Shorts already use question titles and do not separate by it (public views seen 28/10, single channel, ages differ, so a hint only): 'Why Did God Regret Making Man?' 466; 'Am I My Brother's Keeper?' 183; 'The Man Who Never Died?' 156; 'Where Art Thou?' 129; 'Did God Really Say That?' 123. Four of five question titles sit at 123-183 views, the same range as the earlier non-question parts (123-303 lifetime).
question_titles.conclusion: Does NOT support question titles as a driver; the evidence neither validates nor refutes them (no weak sample). It is a free choice: keep it as a hypothesis for the live loop and do not present it as validated in plans or checks. The hygiene (title names the character or place) is met by the three proposals.

gate_proposal: none: nothing validated, so no title or thumbnail gate (plan_check and frozen QA untouched).
next_sample: To reach the bar: 3 weak Shorts from >= 2 more channels and 3 weak longs from >= 1 more channel, same form, aged >= 10 days, taken with vidiq_channel_videos from the winners' own channels (it carries each channel's own history for the norm); about 5-6 calls, 25-30 credits, on a day with research budget free.
